title: LocalOS Model Catalog
description: Schema for models.json — the LocalOS community model catalog.

updated.description: Date the catalog was last updated (YYYY-MM-DD).

id.description: MLC model ID, used to load the model with WebLLM.

name.description: Short human-readable name shown in the UI.

family.description: Model family name (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Phi, Mistral, Hermes, etc.).

vramMB.description: Approximate VRAM or RAM required in megabytes.

category.description: Size category: nano under 1 GB, small 1 to 2.5 GB, medium 2.5 to 4.5 GB, large 4.5 GB and up.

tags.description: Optional tags such as recommended, coding, multilingual, reasoning.

description.description: One or two sentence description shown to the user.
